definition: Project Debater is an IBM artificial intelligence project, designed to participate in a full live debate with expert human debaters.
details: It follows on from the Watson project which played Jeopardy!

explainer.lead: Project Debater is an IBM artificial intelligence project designed to take part in a full live debate with expert human debaters. It matters as a step from question-answering toward argumentation in real time.

tiers.eli5: It's an IBM computer built to stand on a stage and argue its case in a live debate against skilled human debaters.
tiers.practitioner: The project builds on IBM's Watson, which played Jeopardy!, extending that lineage toward live debate participation. A practical consideration is that it is scoped to debate rather than general tasks.
tiers.paperLevel: Project Debater is an IBM AI project designed to participate in a full live debate with expert human debaters, following on from the Watson project that played Jeopardy!. Its scope is debate participation rather than general problem solving.

explainer.example: Project Debater takes part in a live debate format against expert human debaters, presenting and arguing positions.
